liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugaree** (1 review): Jack Straw is cut into a 17-minute Sugaree, with a few other abrupt cuts [18]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer calls this their favorite China>Rider version from any era of the band [15]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Looks Like Rain features a nice intro with thunder drums, according to the reviewer [23]
- **Gloria Jam** (1 review): Gloria Jam smokes, and the following jam is described as a completely different work of art [26]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Reviewer repeatedly listened to the Not Fade Away intro, which led to their long-term fandom [25]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Reviewer highlights the Black Peter performance, noting it features a very good extended solo [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-12-01.sick-bits-15.matrix.chappell.31946.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 221 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1979-12-01.dts.haugh.34294.flac**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 215 min [2]. Said about its sound: The first set SBD is slightly slow in pitch, while the second set is in pitch [2]
- **gd1979-12-01.aud.unknown.31330.flac16**: audience recording; 22 songs; 187 min; rated 3.8/5 by 5 [3]. Said about its sound: The AUD tape was made within the first fifteen rows and is an excellent recording [3]
- **gd1979-12-01.sbd.miller.96408.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 177 min; rated 4.55/5 by 22 [5]
- **gd79-12-01.sbd.miller.29429.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 178 min; rated 4.42/5 by 12 [6]
- **gd79-12-01.sbd.barbella.6022.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 175 min; rated 4.2/5 by 15 [9]. Said about its sound: The recording has good quality and a laid-back, mellow groove typical of that era; First set sounds terrific, but the second set is low volume with missing high frequencies [15][18]
- **gd79-12-01.sbd.set2.clugston.319.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 106 min; rated 4.58/5 by 24 [14]. Said about its sound: Bobby's guitar had a unique steely sound in 1979, while Brent was learning the ropes; The download sound quality is excellent, satisfying the reviewer after years of missing the second set [22]

## Around the show

- Reviewer joined Jerry in lead vocals on Black Peter, describing the performance as rocking [24]
- A friend left a copy of the show at the reviewer's house in 1981 [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-12-01.sick-bits-15.matrix.chappell.31946.flac16**: taped by See info files for details; transferred by Chris Chappell; source: Soundboard and Audience Matrix (see info file) [1]
- **gd1979-12-01.dts.haugh.34294.flac**: taped by See info files for details; transferred by Dan Haugh; source: Soundboard and Audience Matrix (see info file) [2]. Also: A 5.1 and matrix mix were created from the AUD source and SBD [2]
- **gd1979-12-01.aud.unknown.31330.flac16**: taped by Unknown, perhpas Scott Jones; transferred by Andrew F; source: AUD (unknown equipment and lineage, see note below) [3]. Also: Likely taped by Scott Jones using Shure mics into a Sony TC-158 cassette deck [3]
- **gd1979-12-01.sbd.miller.96408.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M/UDXL-II) -> Dat (Panasonic SV3800/48k) [5]. Also: Me And My Uncle is supplied from a re-master of shnid=29429 [5]
- **gd79-12-01.sbd.miller.29429.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [6]. Also: SBD source went to Sony TCD5M cassette, then Panasonic DAT, transferred by Charlie Miller [6]
- **gd79-12-01.sbd.barbella.6022.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [9]
- **gd79-12-01.sbd.set2.clugston.319.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [14]. Also: Reviewer has possessed a good quality audio tape of this show for over 20 years [21]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1979-12-01 Sat Stanley Theatre, Pittsburgh, PA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1022260390927/december-1-1979-stanley-theater) [28]
